name: Docling
summary: Open-source document parser that converts PDF, Office, HTML, audio, images and more into Markdown, JSON or DocTags for gen-AI pipelines; includes an MCP server.
description: Advanced PDF understanding (layout, reading order, tables, formulas), OCR, VLM support, local execution, a CLI, an API server (docling-serve) and integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI and Haystack.
